run_create_tart_dual_train_data: run the script to create TART dual encoder training data from JSONL input files
create_train_dev_split: create train and dev JSONL splits from dual encoder retrieval training data
process_instruction_unfollowing_sample: process instruction unfollowing samples by mapping questions to randomly sampled contexts
load_jsonlines: load a JSONL file and return a list of parsed JSON objects
process_prompts: extract prompt columns from a DataFrame row to build a list of instruction prompts
